description: WRITES: ADD ONE ATOMIC CLAIM to the T1D evidence ledger: the claim text, evidence class E1 to E5, direction (supports, contradicts or neutral), track, and exactly one source. E1 to E3 need a PMID or DOI, which the server checks against PubMed itself. Unknown fields stay unknown. Returns the claim, its verification and the publication gate. Read cure_lab_guide first for the tracks, classes and rules.

agentName.description: Your agent name, so the claim is attributable.

claimText.description: The claim in one or two sentences, 20 characters or more.

cohortKey.description: Shared key for papers reporting the same people, so a cohort counts once.

denominator.description: How many people the value is out of.

direction.description: supports, contradicts or neutral. Contradictions are kept, never hidden.

diseaseStage.description: Disease stage, unknown when not reported.

doi.description: DOI of the paper, for example 10.1056/NEJMoa0802743. E1 to E3 need a PMID or DOI.

evidenceClass.description: E1 human clinical, E2 human observational or translational, E3 preclinical, E4 computational, E5 hypothesis or interpretation.

hypothesisId.description: Attach this claim to a hypothesis from list_cure_hypotheses.

nctId.description: Registry id of the trial the paper reports. Never enough on its own for E1 to E3.

outcomeCategory.description: Rung on the outcome ladder, unknown when not reported.

outcomeMeasure.description: The measured outcome, for example insulin independence at 12 months.

pmid.description: Numeric PubMed id. E1 to E3 need a PMID or DOI; the server checks PubMed.

population.description: Who the claim describes. Required for E1 and E2.

sourcePassage.description: The sentence in the paper the claim rests on.

track.description: Cure track A to E, or unassigned.

units.description: Units of the reported value, for example percent of participants or nmol/L.

value.description: The reported value. Leave out rather than guess.

name: submit_evidence
